drill_pasted_smd.method: Native PAD.GetEffectiveShape(copper_layer).Collide(SHAPE_CIRCLE(via_position, drill_radius), 0), for SMD pads with matching copper and paste layers; includes same-net and different-net contact, including boundary touch.

invariants.normalization: Whitespace, equivalent decimal spelling, and net-code renumbering only; native net names/pad connectivity remain exact. Top-level generation metadata is not an invariant. Board-zone definitions ignore only direct filled_polygon/fill_segments children and direct optional yes/no fill-state atoms within fill; a resulting empty fill node is omitted. All other zone/keepout fields and nested fill rules remain exact.

limitations: This is a reroute invariant/geometric regression gate, not manufacturing release approval.
Native DRC/ERC JSON is supplied evidence. JSON does not bind source contents cryptographically; run fresh native reports against these exact hashed sources.
An empty schematic_parity array alone cannot prove --schematic-parity was enabled; the DRC invocation must be recorded and reviewed.
Inherited drill/pasted-SMD contacts are counted explicitly; the gate forbids new contacts and does not certify inherited contacts as manufacturable.
No impedance, current capacity, thermal, EMC, USB compliance, component or fabrication qualification is performed.
